FUNCTION HAS_CYCLE ACCEPTS(head)
  tortoise <- head
  hare <- head
  WHILE tortoise != NULL AND hare != NULL AND hare.next != NULL
    tortoise <- tortoise.next
    hare <- hare.next.next
    IF tortoise == hare THEN
      RETURN TRUE
    END IF
  END WHILE
  RETURN FALSE
END FUNCTION
